The '''ComNet Communications Complex''' was one of the largest and most important structures in the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]] on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]]. Housing powerful transmission dishes, [[laser-link coupling]]s, and [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]], it was a vital communications link to the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The complex was owned and operated by [[ComNet Corporation]].<ref name="Game" />
